Rates, fees and offer details

†0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 months from account opening, then a 19.24%-29.99% variable APR based on your creditworthiness. Balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer ($5 minimum). Balance transfers must be completed within 120 days of account opening.

*Earn a $300 bonus after you spend $3,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Subject to credit approval. Bonus not available if you have received a new cardmember bonus in the last 24 months.

1$0 intro annual fee for the first year, then $95.

22% cash back: 1% when you buy and 1% when you pay. Cash back does not apply to balance transfers or cash advances. 5% foreign transaction fee.

3New customers only. To earn $400, receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $5,000 or more within 90 days. Keep the account open for at least 90 days. $12 monthly maintenance fee unless you maintain a minimum daily balance of $1,500.
